req.title: Reject non-GET on /get
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 405 Method Not Allowed for any non-GET request to /get.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the /get endpoint should only accept GET requests and return a 405 Method Not Allowed for any other HTTP methods. This ensures that the endpoint behaves correctly according to the HTTP specification and prevents misuse of the endpoint with unsupported methods.

tests.name: test_get_method_allowed
actions: Send a GET request to the /get endpoint.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/get')
assert response.status_code == 200

tests.name: test_non_get_methods_rejected
actions: Send a POST request to the /get endpoint.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.post('/get')
assert response.status_code == 405

tests.name: test_boundary_case_for_method_check
actions: Send a PUT request to the /get endpoint.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.put('/get')
assert response.status_code == 405
